executive_summary: The poet explores everyday small objects—a piece of chalk, moss, a spiderweb, a water drop—through a convex magnifying lens. The lens transforms chalk into snow caverns and moss into dense forests. The poem concludes by linking small hand lenses to astronomical telescopes, celebrating optical tools that expand human perception.
